answer: Farming becomes a dawn bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every jetty settlement recomputes the pulse schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
